name: JG_FSCL_HDRS_ATRB_EXT_ALL
description: This table contains additional transaction header level attributes required for generating fiscal document. These attributes are populated through the UI component provided by Fiscal Document Generation (FDG). For inbound fiscal document, this table is populated by the FDG process once the document is successfully validated.

columns.name: DOC_EXT_HDR_ID
columns.description: Document extension header identifier.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier of a transaction.

columns.name: MAT_ISSUE_RECPT_DATE
columns.description: Material issue or receipt date for the transaction.

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of service document provided in the associated transaction such as RPS for regular service FD, RPS-M for Mixed FD and RPS-C for Fiscal Coupon related FD.

columns.name: FREIGHT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of freight applicable to the fiscal document.

columns.name: PAYMENT_OPTION
columns.description: Payment option of the transaction. Valid values are 0 for cash payment, 1 for installment payment, and 2 for others.

columns.name: WAGON_IDENTIFICATION
columns.description: Wagon identification for freight invoices.

columns.name: FERRY_IDENTIFICATION
columns.description: Ferry identification for freight invoices.

columns.name: QUANTITY_CARRIED
columns.description: Quantity of goods carried, such as number of boxes.

columns.name: GOODS_TYPE_CARRIED
columns.description: Type of carried goods applicable for freight invoice.

columns.name: GOODS_BRAND_CARRIED
columns.description: Brand of carried goods applicable for freight invoice.

columns.name: CONTAINER_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Unique identifier for a container of carried goods.

columns.name: NET_WEIGHT
columns.description: Net weight recorded in kilograms.

columns.name: GROSS_WEIGHT
columns.description: Gross weight measured in kilograms.

columns.name: SEAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Seal number provided in freight invoice of the transporter.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_STATEMENT_IDENT
columns.description: Statement of commitment identification.

columns.name: PURCHASE_CONTRACT
columns.description: Purchase contract information for reporting to tax authority.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INDUSTRY_TYPE
columns.description: A unique identifier of the industry associated with the transaction.

columns.name: SERIES
columns.description: Tax document series, to be filled with zero when there is no series.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_DATE
columns.description: Date when the fiscal document is issued.

columns.name: DOC_NATURE
columns.description: Fiscal document nature. Possible values are 1 for standard, 2 for complementary, and 3 for adjustment.

columns.name: SERVICE_SITUATION
columns.description: Operation situation code under the simplified taxation system.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_TYPE
columns.description: The fiscal document contingency type. Valid values are Security Form, Contingency System of National Environment, and Declaration of Issuance Provided in Contingency.

columns.name: FREIGHT_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Carrier or party site identifier that provided freight services for shipment.

columns.name: TRX_FD_TYPE_DETERMINANT
columns.description: Fiscal document type determinant, which indicates if single or multiple fiscal documents are required for a transaction.

columns.name: REF_DOC_NUM
columns.description: Reference document number of the transaction.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_KEY
columns.description: Key identifier for a reference fiscal document.

columns.name: REF_FISCAL_DOC_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the reference transaction occurred.

columns.name: REF_MODEL
columns.description: Model for the fiscal document associated with the reference transaction.

columns.name: REF_SERIES
columns.description: Tax document series of the reference document.

columns.name: REF_DOC_ISSUER_STATE_CODE
columns.description: State code for the reference document issuer.

columns.name: REF_ISSUER_TAXPAYER_ID
columns.description: Tax registration identifier for the reference document taxpayer.

columns.name: REF_RURAL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the reference document was issued in rural area.

columns.name: REF_COMPLEMENTARY_FD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the reference document is fiscal document where document nature is complementary and issued for correction of the original fiscal document.

columns.name: SERVICE_TAX_PAID_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether ISS tax has been paid to the municipality.

columns.name: TAX_SETTLEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date on the certificate provided by the muncipality on payment of taxes.

columns.name: WHT_SOCIAL_INTG_PROG_AMT
columns.description: Total withheld amount of contribution for the social integration program.

columns.name: WHT_SS_FINANCING_AMT
columns.description: Total withheld amount of contribution for the social security financing.

columns.name: SERVICE_SERIES
columns.description: Tax document series for services fiscal documents.

columns.name: FSCL_ATTRIB_TEMPLATE_CODE
columns.description: The default template to be used for the defaulting fiscal attributes.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_REQD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Fiscal Document should be accounted for on the tax authority approval.

columns.name: ISSUING_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Issuing purpose for a communication service fiscal document. Values include Regular, Adjustment, Substitution.

columns.name: BILLING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Billing type used in a communication service fiscal document. Values include Regular, Centralized or Co-billing.

columns.name: APPROVER_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Tax authority approver site used for a communication service fiscal document approval.

columns.name: REF_HASH_CODE
columns.description: Hash code stamped on an approved fiscal document model 21 so that a new communication fiscal document may replace it to correct issues.

columns.name: REF_SUBSTITUTION_REASON
columns.description: Free text field for the user to provide the reason for substitution.

columns.name: SUBSTITUTION_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if a transaction is a substitution or sustituted fiscal document.

columns.name: REF_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The source type of a fiscal document used as a reference.

columns.name: OPERATION_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: A user-defined code that represents fiscal documents grouped by operation according to the tax authority rules.
